definition: First-class API support for common production failure modes — not roll-your-own inside a tool.

legend.first_class: Native first-class API in the framework (named surface, documented failure→recovery)
legend.pattern: Official docs recommend a pattern, middleware, or companion package — not a core native API
legend.absent: No documented first-class API or recommended pattern; team must invent
legend.unknown: Could not verify from primary docs at audit time

notes: FMC% is a weighted judgment (DUR/HIT/SCH weighted higher), not a raw first_class count. All cells EST from dossiers + primary docs.
